title: Chiselling
description: Simple Chiselling mod for getting items a new way! (and maybe riches too)
body:
This mod simply adds a Chisel to the game where you can chisel things! (yeah pretty obvious)

There isnt much to the Chisel right now but you can get new items from chiseling stuff!

## Items you can Chisel:

Stone: Sand Grains

Andesite: Sand Grains

Granite: Sand Grains

Diorite: Sand Grains

Deepslate: Gravel Grains

Oak Log: Oak Bark

Birch Log: Birch Bark

Sand: 90% chance to break but in return 3 Sand Grains / 10% chance to become Suspicious Sand

Currently for only 1.21.11, more support for other versions probably soon or not i dont really know
